description: Local Bridges is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The bridge inventory data was obtained from Caltrans Structure Maintenance and Investigations (SM&I) Database as of 03/12/2024. Bridge inspectors maintain the safety and integrity of 12,601 bridges owned by local government agencies by performing inspections in accordance with federal regulations. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Bridges, California, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Division of Maintenance. The bounding box given is -124.4004,32.5465,-114.1792,41.9967. The hub shows 2024-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No restrictions on public use.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
